title: Produce encoded CRT offsets from actual current child coordinates
body:
The actual balanced CRT caller reconstructs a left integer from **current transformed child coordinates**. Existing encoded triangular offsets use original lower coordinates, and the fixed key port consumes supplied ROM data. This adds the missing encoded current-child numerical producer and completes its right-node offset/padded-coordinate consumer.

Concrete source witness: moduli `(5,7)` and current coordinates `(1,5)` reconstruct `11`; right modulus `13` gets offset `7`. Treating those coordinates as original mixed-radix digits yields `26` and wrong offset `0`, despite both being individually valid.

The new `Arithmetic` explicitly admits any modulus `1<M<2^(P-1)` in a common P-bit arena and implements modular operations from retained unsigned bit-tape primitives. It does not call or bypass the frozen `Ring` constructor, whose stricter significant-bit guard remains unchanged and tested. No runtime integer decoding, word-backing read, bit_length or times_small(decoded modulus) is used.

The written proof covers arbitrary finite nonempty left/right groups with pairwise coprime moduli and complete product below `2^(P-1)`. It proves locally scaled reconstruction, all successive right prefixes, invalid-left disabling, preservation of padded right coordinates, borrowed byte/head preservation and complete owned cleanup. At most 32 numerical slots are live in a fixed 64-slot arena; a conservative `2^20*(P+2)^4` bound counts source-tape/control operations. This is not unconditionally substituted for a complete literal binary E(p,ell) implementation.

Validation (CPython 3.12, standard library):

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/encoded-current-crt --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/encoded-current-crt
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/encoded-current-crt --check-source-history
```

- Ordinary and optimized registered replay pass: 1239 complete modular operand pairs, 119 unit/nonunit inverses, all 64 eight-valued current left-coordinate pairs, invalid padding and moduli exceeding the finite small-multiplier vocabulary.
- Varied 1+1/1+2/2+2/3+3 groups at P=4,8,12,20,32 use the same producer. Eight dirty borrowed words at noninitial heads and the arena template remain unchanged; observed peak is at most 26 slots.
- Four original balanced-root cases and four complete original mixed-width Callers check every numerical offset/level endpoint against unchanged source Beneš rows at declared widths `(4,4,4,5)`. Each module receives an encoded source-derived fixture; this is not an uninterrupted physical whole-tree execution.
- Three actual semantic mutants misinterpret current coordinates, omit a preceding right modulus or reduce padded values. Eleven rejection cases check noncoprime inputs, capacity/domain limits, empty groups, short framing and late failure after output production; cleanup is inspected before fixture disposal.
- Source-history/committed bytes, official export integrity, read-only Git-free ordinary/optimized replay, live-source corruption and type-changing frozen-receipt controls pass. These are reproduction and source-binding evidence, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19140230 . Card `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined to the actual current-child numeric boundary. Scientific base `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`, priority revision 7. Initial overlap covered all 6710 notes, 320 open PR bodies and 4130 Discussion records with complete inventory/pagination; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

Family decision: narrow to this complete local numerical module, then stop. Initialized arena/parameter/descriptor production and transport, literal binary control compilation, complete ROM/Beneš construction, raw macro, sparse repair, ordinary interchanges, full E and native/outer transfer remain external. No supplier, selected frontier, complete multiplication theorem, speedup or new kappa is claimed. README/TASK preserve bounded next questions.
